description: This PHP class defines a Drupal migration process plugin for handling field instance settings during data migration from Drupal 7. It manages various field types such as taxonomy term references, entity references, node references, user references, and boolean lists, transforming their settings accordingly.

classes.name: FieldInstanceSettings
classes.description: A Drupal migration process plugin class for transforming field instance settings during migration from Drupal 7.
